newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Air Macau to fly to China's Qingdao - agency.
newsitem.headline: Air Macau to fly to China's Qingdao - agency.

text.p: Air Macau will launch a thrice-weekly service between the northern Chinese city of Qingdao and Macau from March 23, the Portuguese Lusa news agency said on Thursday.
Air Macau also flies to three other Chinese cities from the Portuguese-administrated territory's international ariport. They are Beijing, Shanghai and Xiamen.
With the addition of Qingdao, the fledging flag carrier of the Portuguese-run territory's network would comprise seven destinations from totalling 83 flights a week, Lusa said.
The other two cities Air Macau operated are Taipei and Bangkok.

Air Macau is owned 14 percent by casino operator Sociedade De Turismo e Diversoes de Macau, 51 percent by China state-owned Air China, 25 percent by TAP-Air Portugal, five percent by the Macau government and five percent by other investors.
